aggregation: OR across supplied six channels on common 5min grid
resampling: retrospective nonoverlapping 5min median; bin prediction begins at bin END; missing bins no extrapolated alarm
partition_boundary_policy: move cut forward beyond any same-ID event envelope it intersects; reject non-increasing boundaries; whole event group assigned once
fit: per-channel median/MAD on MODEL_TRAIN observed bins excluding all annotated categories
threshold_policy: fixed engineering threshold before evaluation; no tuning on any external labels
